name: INTC Run 2026
short_description: INTC Run 2026 is a half-marathon and multi-distance road race in Laoag, Ilocos Norte, Philippines, set for August 23, 2026.
ai_summary: INTC Run 2026 is a multi-distance road race scheduled for August 23, 2026, organized by INTC at SM City Laoag in Laoag, Ilocos Norte, Philippines. Participants can choose from four distances: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, making it accessible to a range of runners from beginners to half-marathoners. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Offers four distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km) to suit different fitness levels
Held at an accessible, well-known venue, SM City Laoag
Organized by INTC, giving the event a clear organizing body
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

faqs.question: When is INTC Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: INTC Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 23, 2026. The event will be held in Laoag, Ilocos Norte, Philippines, at the SM City Laoag venue. No further schedule details, such as specific start times for each distance category, have been announced yet.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at INTC Run 2026?
faqs.answer: INTC Run 2026 offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km race, a 5km race, and a 3km race. This range of distances allows both experienced long-distance runners and casual participants to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for INTC Run 2026?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for INTC Run 2026 has not yet been announced. Prospective participants will need to wait for further details from the organizer, INTC, regarding when and how registration will open for the various distance categories offered at this event.

faqs.question: Where is INTC Run 2026 held?
faqs.answer: INTC Run 2026 is held at SM City Laoag, located in the city of Laoag, Ilocos Norte, in the Philippines. This venue serves as the base for the race, which includes multiple distance categories ranging from a 3km fun run up to a 21.1km half-marathon.
